title: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists a black-body temperature of 254 K
summary: The fact sheet lists a black-body temperature of 254 kelvin, a different line from the surface average temperature.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists a black-body temperature of 254.0 kelvin. The same sheet's surface average temperature is a different line and is already recorded on the dry-air card. This card does not subtract the two temperatures or name that difference a greenhouse effect. A NOAA page states a greenhouse claim separately.

sources.title: Earth Fact Sheet
sources.author: David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, NSSDCA
